name: Warfare
overview: Scripture reveals that warfare for the believer is fundamentally spiritual, involving a struggle not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces of darkness (Ephesians 6:12). Victory is assured not by human strength or power but through the Spirit of God and the armor He provides (Zechariah 4:6; Ephesians 6:11). Believers are empowered to overcome the enemy and any weapon formed against them will not prosper, as they are more than conquerors through Christ's love (Isaiah 54:17; Luke 10:19; Romans 8:37).
